title: Attachment
description: Discover the liberating power of non-attachment, learning how to engage fully with life without being bound by expectations or cravings.

sutra.meaning: Mind becomes calm by detachment or contemplation on realised sages

sections.insight: Letting go brings peace or complete focus on each posture and each breath.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Am I able to maintain focus?
sections.practice: Observe yourself whenever you feel attachment and possesiveness to people and objects.
sections.gurudevInsight: If you do this, you chita, your mind will be pleasant. In that gracious, graceful mind, one pointedness becomes very much easy, very simple, hmm! Practice one thing or devotion to one thing or one aspect. Ok, Even that becomes difficult, he says, there is another sutra. “Prachardanvidharanbhya va pranasya” Breaking the rhythms of the breath, the natural rhythms of the breath & holding the breath, sustaining the breath in different rhythms. If someone asks you, where did Patanjali talked about kriya, Patanjali has not mentioned about Sudarshan kriya directly. [PDF p.40]

sutra.meaning: Suffering comes from 1. ignorance or lack of wisdom, 2.ego, 3.attachment to pleasure, 4.aversion to pain and 5.fear of death. These are the root causes of disturbance in our equilibrium.

sections.insight: All sufferings have one or the other of these at its root.
sections.reflectionPrompt: Can I see their presence in me?
sections.practice: Recall incidents causing you distress and identify the reason at their root. Identify one pattern.
sections.journalPrompt: What did I find at the root?
sections.shlokaFrom: आपूर्यमाणमचलप्रतिष्ठं समुद्रमापः प्रविशन्ति यद्वत्।तद्वत्कामा यं प्रविशन्ति सर्वे स शान्तिमाप्नोति न कामकामी॥ 2.70
sections.wisdomFrom: A person who is not disturbed by the incessant flow of desires - that enter like rivers into the ocean, which is ever being filled but is always still - can alone achieve peace, and not the man who strives to satisfy such desires.
sections.gurudevInsight: You know its benefits, the result of this action is very good, will be beneficial for me so I want to do it, like doing exercises. People go to gymnasium, weight lifting, it’s not a joke, its not giving any big pleasure to do that, lifting the weight, its not a pleasurable job or bicycling but one does it, why? They know that it is good for your system. Swadhyaya, being alert, self-study, observing the breath, observing the emotions, thoughts, what all happens inside you – observing, studying yourself i.e. Ishwarapranidhana: devotion to the Divine, love to the Divine- these three things together makes kirya yoga. They reduce the sufferings, they reduce the misery in life. [PDF p.57]

sections.theme: Ignorance is the root of all pain.

sutra.meaning: Spiritual ignorance is the root of all suffering because it may cause arrogance, cravings, aversion, attachment etc which are impediments to growth and cause suffering.

sections.insight: Unawareness fuels all reactions which cause karmic residue.
sections.reflectionPrompt: am I unaware of who I really am?
sections.practice: Observe your reactions in all situations specially those that cause you suffering.
sections.gurudevInsight: That’s why a growing child sleeps longer. The youth sleeps more than an aged person because there is lot of activity, metabolic activity going on in a youth. If you deprive somebody of sleep, you will see their growth also gets, shunted. At the same time in every activity there is a corner that is very silent. Krishna tells Arjuna, Arjuna, you know, who is really intelligent & clever? “One who sees silence in activity & activity in silence, he is the intelligent person. [PDF p.56]

sections.theme: We mistake the temporary for truth.

sutra.meaning: Confusing temporary as permanent is ignorance for example assuming the world to be prmanent.

sections.insight: Misperception creates suffering. Life itself is impermanent so everything else around it too is not permanent.
sections.reflectionPrompt: What am I holding as permanent which is not so?
sections.gurudevInsight: Many people get disease or die not out of hunger but out of overeating. Today in the world very few people die out of 59 hunger. But more & more people are out of overeating; because we have not allowed that fire of hunger to come up, we have never kindled that. When you fast also, every cell of your body becomes alive; fasting is a very good therapy. It can cleanse your system, the Jataragni can cleanse you of all toxins. When your head is clogged with worry, tension & unpleasant thoughts, nightmares, fasting would be a very great help. [PDF p.59]

sutra.meaning: Ego is identification of seer with seeing ie the body, mind and intellect as the eternal, indestructible Self

sections.gurudevInsight: But the whole focus is in the event, is on the happening rather than just the time. Suppose someone is waiting for a bus to come or train to come or boat to come he will go on seeing, is the bus coming? The whole focus is on the object rather than just that time. Just a little shift is done, a tilt, whether waiting for a doctor, waiting for or bus, or train, or something just wait for the moment, this moment. Mind is in the moment waiting for nothing but it is waiting. It adds a different quality to the consciousness. [PDF p.56]

sections.insight: We cling to what feels good.
sections.shlokaFrom: ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते |आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः || 5.22
sections.wisdomFrom: The pleasures that arise from contact with the sense objects, though appearing as enjoyable to worldly-minded people, are verily a source of misery. O son of Kunti, such pleasures have a beginning and an end, and so the wise do not delight in them.

sections.practice: Face all discomfort with dispassion today.
sections.gurudevInsight: 2) And then there is a second type of fire that is called Kamagni: the fire of Desire. When the desire, the fire of desire comes, it gulps you. The fire of desire or lust, passion is kama-agni. It is because of this fire of passion that life continues on this planet. Fire of passion is present in all the species of creation. 3) Third type of fire is called Jataragni - Fire of Hunger & digestion :- This is one of the important principles in ayurveda – Jataragani. [PDF p.58]

sections.theme: Fear persists even in the wise.

sutra.meaning: Fear of loss persists even in the wise

sections.insight: Fear is deeply rooted. All fear emanates from the fear of death.
sections.practice: Observe the fears you confront today, no matter how small.
sections.gurudevInsight: See, when some one is anxious, he is very aware of time, every moment passing, isn’t it? But the whole focus is in the event, is on the happening rather than just the time. Suppose someone is waiting for a bus to come or train to come or boat to come he will go on seeing, is the bus coming? The whole focus is on the object rather than just that time. Just a little shift is done, a tilt, whether waiting for a doctor, waiting for or bus, or train, or something just wait for the moment, this moment. [PDF p.56]

If you don’t cleanse your consciousness of there 5 miseries, impurities, sources of misery, then you will have to suffer in this life & the next. There is no way, you will have to suffer in this life, you have to undergo this suffering, this misery not only in this life but in coming life also because they form as karmashaya a bank of karma, they get into the reserve tank in you as karma tank & through Meditation this Karma can be washed out, eliminated, right now, here. Before the body drops you, you get rid of the karma & lessen the sheets of ignorance over you; otherwise there is no escape for you from this. [PDF p.71]

sections.reflectionPrompt: What pattern repeats in my life?
sections.practice: Observe patterns and cycles occuring in your life.
sections.gurudevInsight: Inability to see the Self, & the buddhi or the intellect & the power of the instrument of perception as separate is Asmita. Craving: - Raga, craving: - and craving comes with a pleasant experience. You have a pleasant experience & that creates a craving in you & this craving makes you miserable, this is beautiful. Patanjali has said, there are only 5 sources of misery, there is no 6th source of misery. Ignorance is thinking that which is changing as non-changing. We try to control others mind saying we should be this way, we should be that way. [PDF p.68]

There is a depth in you, a silent corner in you, that is the Seer & that is true – this whole space is so silent, in the silent space the entire activity is happening, every atom is revolving around the nucleus, all the planets are moving around & yet it is all very silent. The purpose of this is kleshatanukarana - to reduce the suffering or misery in life & samadhibhavana - to bring about samadhi, harmony, equanimity in life. What are the root causes of misery in life? “Avidyaasmitaragadweshabhinivesha panchklesha” 1) Ignorance :-Avidya - is root cause of suffering. [PDF p.67]

sections.theme: The wise see suffering in change.

sutra.meaning: Wise see suffering in all change

sections.gurudevInsight: This self study leads you upwards to the universe that is unknown to us. Self-study takes you a step further & self-study eliminates misery & suffering of the mind. Buddha had said this so beautifully, he said kayanupaschana that is Tapas – observe the body – vednanupaschana - Observe the sensations in the body – chittaupaschana - observe the mind, the impressions in the mind, thoughts in the mind, feelings in the mind – dharmaupaschana - observe your very nature that you are, observe the Dharma, the nature that you are. Four steps Buddha has said & the same thing patanjali has said – Tapas swadhyaya Ishwara Pranidhana. [PDF p.66]

sections.reflectionPrompt: can I prevent suffering in the future?

sections.wisdomFrom: He who seated like one unconcerned is not moved by the modes of nature, who remains firm and never wavers, knowing that the modes alone are active.

sections.theme: The seer is not the seen.

sutra.meaning: Union of seer and seen causes suffering

sections.practice: Observe separation. Observe how it will make you feel.
sections.shlokaFrom: असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः।नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां सन्न्यासेनाधिगच्छति॥ 18.49
sections.wisdomFrom: He whose intellect is unattached everywhere, who has subdued his self, from whom desire has fled - he attains the supreme perfection of freedom from action through renunciation.

sutra.meaning: Desires are beginningless and have existed eternally as the desire to live is eternal.

sections.shlokaFrom: यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्वनुषज्जते।सर्वसङ्कल्पसंन्यासी योगारूढस्तदोच्यते॥ 6.4
sections.wisdomFrom: When one is neither attached to sense objects nor to actions, such a person is said to be elevated in the science of Yog, having renounced all desires for the fruits of actions.
sections.gurudevInsight: It cannot provide you the rest that you are longing for. Your mind is tired, is burnt down through its galloping on desires after desires. Just turn back & see all the desires you have achieved, have they given you rest? They have created few more desires & you are on it. They only gave you more hope that you can achieve more, you can have more & that has put you on another trip. You know these merry go rounds have these horses. [PDF p.16]

sections.theme: Remove the cause, remove the effect.

sutra.meaning: Impressions and desires are bound by cause and effect. Removing cause removes effect

sections.practice: Go deeper into your deep desires.
sections.shlokaFrom: तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर।असक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः॥ 3.19
sections.wisdomFrom: Therefore, without attachment, perform always the work that has to be done, for man attains the highest by doing work without attachment.
sections.gurudevInsight: These do not touch that very sensitive, purest core of your Being, of your existence, which is the Lord or creation. That consciousness which is free from this & Asheya means latent desires or impressions or opinions, seeds. So when this consciousness or that Being which is free from Kalesha i.e. sufferings or misery, Karma action, vipaka-the fruit of action & Asheya - impressions of actions. not somewhere hanging in the sky, its in your heart. Whatever action you do, whatever events happen around you, it does not touch central point of your life. [PDF p.28]
